Most of Klarna’s revenue comes from fees that stores pay to offer Klarna at checkout. They choose Klarna because it helps more people complete their purchases smoothly and feel confident while shopping. Klarna earns a smaller amount from interest on our financing products and from late fees when payments are missed. These late fees are clear, limited, and often avoided completely. Klarna also provides reminders and flexible payment options to help people stay in control of their spending.
To be eligible to use Klarna:
Be a resident of the United States or its territories
Be at least eighteen years old or of legal age in your state of residence.
Have a valid card/bank account.
Have full legal capacity to enter into a contract.
Accurately provide your true and correct personal details.
Be able to receive security verification codes via text message.

A valid Social Security Number (SSN) and a linked card or bank account may be required to use certain Klarna products, such as Pay in 4 and other credit-based payment options, as well as our banking products. Read our terms and conditions for more information.
